# Third-party component

This directory contains the unmodified browser bundle from `@google/model-viewer` 4.1.0, published by the [model-viewer project](https://github.com/google/model-viewer). The package is distributed under the accompanying Apache 2.0 license. The bundle retains its original notices.

The application accepts local GLB files supplied by the user. This component does not include any TFT character meshes or textures.
